jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

jobs.title: Finance & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are a fast\-paced creative fabrication company looking for an organized, detail\-oriented **Finance \& Administrative Coordinator** to support our day\-to\-day finance and business operations.

This is a varied, hands\-on role ideal for someone who is comfortable with QuickBooks and spreadsheets, communicates well, and enjoys keeping things organized and moving forward.

Responsibilities

* Assist with recurring financial, project, payroll, and operational reports.
* Work in QuickBooks to assist with data entry, reporting, reconciliations, and transaction research.
* Monitor Accounts Receivable and follow up on outstanding invoices.
* Assist with Accounts Payable as needed.
* Learn our payroll process and provide backup payroll support as needed.
* Assist with maintaining company schedules, calendars, meetings, and reminders.
* Coordinate interviews and candidate communications.
* Assist with initial phone interviews and conduct reference checks.
* Assist with new\-hire onboarding and setting up employees in company systems.
* Create and maintain checklists, trackers, templates, and internal processes.
* Follow up on missing information and help keep administrative tasks moving.

What We're Looking For

* Experience with **QuickBooks**.
* Strong working knowledge of **Excel and/or Google Sheets**.
* Previous administrative, finance/accounting support, or office coordination experience.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with numbers and reports.
* Organized and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive about following up and completing open items.
* Comfortable handling confidential financial and employee information.
* Willing to learn new systems and take on additional responsibilities.

You do not need to be an accountant or payroll specialist. We're looking for someone who is **dependable, organized, comfortable with numbers, and eager to learn**.

This position will start part\-time at **$23–$28/hour**, with the opportunity to grow into a full\-time role for the right person.

Pay: $23\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Operations Coordinator**

**Summary**

The Operations Coordinator supports day‑to‑day logistics and order fulfillment activities while serving as a key point of contact for customers. This role is responsible for processing B2B and B2C orders, coordinating with warehouses and 3PL partners, maintaining accurate data in ERP/WMS systems, and assisting with inventory, documentation, and billing support. The ideal candidate is detail‑oriented, customer‑focused, and eager to learn logistics operations in a fast‑paced environment. Strong communication skills, teamwork, and basic proficiency in Microsoft Office are preferred, and with Korean language skills considered a requirement.

· Coordinating operational tasks between the customer to warehouse teams.

· Documenting order data, inventory, and accounting details into systems.

· Sole key partner between customers, operations, and vendors in getting the job done.

**Typical Day**

A typical day for the Operations Coordinator begins at 8:00 a.m., reviewing incoming orders, checking inventory levels, and coordinating with the warehouse team to ensure orders are picked, packed, and shipped accurately. Throughout the day, they update order information in the ERP/WMS system, monitor shipments, and respond to customer and client inquiries via email or phone. They work closely with internal teams to resolve any order, inventory, or carrier issues, assist with shipping documentation, and support basic billing activities as needed. The day also includes tracking data, flagging discrepancies, and contributing to small process improvements before wrapping up tasks and handoffs by 5:00 p.m.

· Start at 8:00 a.m. checking emails, and incoming customer orders

· Coordinate with operations teams such as the warehouse, and vendors

· Document what happened in the day, then end at 5:00 p.m.

**Key Responsibilities**  
Operations \& Logistics

* Process B2C orders including pick \& pack, label creation, and tracking updates.
* Support inbound and outbound logistics coordination with the warehouse team.
* Ensure data accuracy in WMS/ERP systems and report any discrepancies.
* Understand 3PL operations basics (receiving, storage, returns, parcel and pallet handling).
* Assist in resolving basic logistics or carrier\-related issues.

Customer Service \& Communication

* Serve as a point of contact for client logistics inquiries via phone and email.
* Communicate order status updates and service notifications to clients.
* Coordinate internally with warehouse and admin teams to resolve client issues.

Order Management \& Inventory

* Enter, track, and update orders in ERP/WMS systems.
* Monitor inventory levels and assist with periodic audits.
* Notify supervisors of inventory shortages or discrepancies.

Documentation \& Compliance

* Assist in preparing shipping documents (BOLs, packing lists, customs forms).
* Follow established SOPs and ensure compliance with customer requirements.

Billing Support

* Help generate service invoices based on agreed rates.
* Assist with tracking billing communications and support payment follow\-ups.

Continuous Improvement Support

* Participate in identifying small process improvements for better efficiency.

· Assist in data collection for reporting operational KPIs.

Additional Tasks as Needed

· Comfortable in office setting

**Requirements**

Education:

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate or Bachelor's degree preferred (especially in Business, Logistics, or related fields).

**Experience:**

* No prior experience required; willingness to learn and adapt is key.
* Previous experience in logistics, customer service, or order processing is a plus.

**Skills:**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent customer service
* Teamwork mindset.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast\-paced environment.
* Detail\-oriented
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).

**Languages:**

* English required.
* Korean fluency required.

**Company Benefits**

· Health, Dental, Vision Insurance – 100% coverage for you and family

· 401(K) with Company Match

· Free Daily Lunch Catering

· Annual performance\-based incentives

· Certification Recognition Program

· Fitness Center Membership Subsidy Program

**Work Conditions**

* Salary: Starting at $52,000 \- $55,000 (based on experience)
* Full time On\-Site Employment
* Location: Carson, CA
* Hours: M\-F, 8AM to 5PM

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $52,000\.00 \- $55,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?

Education:

* Associate (Preferred)

Language:

* Korean (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Compton, CA 90221 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media and Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about digital storytelling and eager to craft compelling social media narratives that engage audiences and elevate brand presence? As a Social Media and Marketing Coordinator, you will be at the forefront of our online marketing efforts, driving innovative campaigns across multiple platforms. Your energetic approach will help us build vibrant communities, enhance brand visibility, and deliver measurable marketing results. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your skills in digital marketing, content creation, and media analytics while working with a dynamic team committed to excellence.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and manage engaging social media content across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok to increase brand awareness and audience engagement.
* Monitor social media channels using tools like Hootsuite or Buffer to track performance metrics, analyze trends, and optimize content strategies based on data insights.
* Conduct social listening to gather insights on audience sentiment, industry trends, and competitor activity to inform content planning and public relations efforts.
* Create visually appealing graphics and videos using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Creative Suite, and video editing tools to enhance content quality.
* Manage social media advertising campaigns on platforms like Facebook Ads to target specific audiences and maximize campaign ROI.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop integrated campaigns that align with branding goals and marketing objectives.
* Engage with followers by responding promptly to comments, messages, and inquiries to foster strong community relationships.
* Track digital marketing performance through analytics tools such as Google Analytics and web analytics platforms to measure campaign effectiveness and inform future strategies.
* Assist in media editing tasks including proofreading content for accuracy, consistency, and brand voice before publishing.
* Support public relations initiatives by coordinating media outreach efforts and managing relationships with influencers and media contacts.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in social media management or digital marketing roles with a strong portfolio of successful campaigns.
* Familiarity with social media platforms’ algorithms, best practices for content marketing, and community engagement strategies.
* Proficiency in graphic design software including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Creative Suite for content creation.
* Experience with social listening tools such as Hootsuite or Buffer for monitoring brand mentions and industry trends.
* Knowledge of digital advertising platforms like Facebook Advertising for campaign setup and optimization.
* Strong understanding of SEO principles, keyword research techniques, and how they integrate into content strategies.
* Ability to analyze marketing data using Google Analytics or similar tools to evaluate performance metrics effectively.
* Excellent communication skills with an eye for detail in proofreading written content for clarity and accuracy.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

Join us as a Social Media and Marketing Coordinator if you’re ready to bring your creativity to life through innovative digital campaigns! This paid role offers a vibrant environment where your ideas can thrive—helping us connect meaningfully with our audiences while advancing your career in digital marketing excellence!

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Build a Career That Changes Lives \- Including Your Own**



24 Hour Home Care is a leading provider of home care and community\-based services focused on helping individuals live safely and independently. As part of TEAM Services Group, a private equity\-backed healthcare services organization, we combine a mission\-driven culture with a commitment to innovation, growth, and operational excellence.


Here, the work you do matters. Whether you're supporting clients directly or helping drive our business forward, every role contributes to improving lives and strengthening the communities we serve.


**Grow with purpose. Lead with heart. Make a difference every day.**



Watch this short video to see the heart behind our work and the impact our teams create every day.



**Who You Are**



You are a *passionate and performance\-driven* team player, eager to take on a key role in our company's growth. You embody Team 24's Care \& Compete Principles and Competencies:

  



In the spirit of *Own(ing) It With Courage*, we encourage you to check out our Glassdoor Page to learn more about 24 Hour Home Care and to leave a review about your experience: 24 Hour Home Care: Glassdoor Page



Sound interesting? Read on for more details!



**The Role**:



The Client Operations Coordinator supports accurate and timely work across the client operations lifecycle, from authorization intake and service delivery through billing, payment, and case resolution. This role helps ensure authorizations and service hours are processed accurately, discrepancies are resolved, and clients and caregivers experience uninterrupted service.



Coordinators are trained across Client Operations functions and assigned to a specific area based on business needs, with the expectation that they develop working knowledge of the full client lifecycle and can support multiple functions as departmental needs evolve.


**Primary Responsibilities**


* Process and maintain client authorizations, verifying service type, units, date ranges, funding sources, and rates; identify discrepancies and support urgent authorization requests and audits.
* Process submitted hours and timesheets, validate alignment with authorized services, and resolve short pays, missing entries, and other processing discrepancies.
* Support pre\-billing accuracy checks, billing closeout, reconciliation, reauthorization tracking, and funds recovery activities to help prevent service and payment disruptions.
* Manage assigned client cases and escalations through resolution, communicating with clients and caregivers and partnering with internal teams to address authorization, service, and billing concerns.
* Maintain accurate documentation, meet established turnaround and compliance requirements, and collaborate with Branch Operations, Revenue Cycle Management, Payroll, Finance, and other partners to resolve issues and improve processes.


**This is a hybrid position, coming into the El Segundo office 3x per week.**


**Work Schedule:** Business hours are 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Depending on the position and business needs, employees may be required to work any scheduled shift within these operating hours.


**What You Bring to the Table**:


**Qualifications**


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 1\+ years of experience in an administrative, operations, billing, customer service, or coordination role.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Experience in home care, healthcare operations, or a Regional Center environment preferred.
* Familiarity with authorization, billing, claims, payroll, or CRM systems such as Salesforce preferred.


**Skills**


* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in high\-volume, deadline\-driven work.
* Organization and prioritization skills with the ability to manage competing deadlines.
* Strong problem\-solving and judgment, including identifying discrepancies and escalating appropriately.
* Clear written and verbal communication with clients, caregivers, and cross\-functional partners.
* Adaptability and ability to learn and apply processes across multiple Client Operations functions.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an energetic and detail\-oriented Customer Service Logistics Coordinator to join our dynamic logistics team which operates our new fashion\-distribution center. In this pivotal role, you will be the key liaison between our warehouse operations, transportation providers, and fashion clients, ensuring seamless coordination of logistics activities. Your expertise will drive process improvements, optimize inventory management, and enhance customer satisfaction through proactive communication and strategic problem\-solving. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are passionate about fashion and supply chain excellence, this opportunity is for you!

**Duties**

* Manage order fulfillment processes, including receiving \& shipping, ensuring timely and accurate delivery to customers.
* Coordinate transportation planning and logistics management using transportation management systems (TMS) and warehouse management systems (WMS).
* Oversee warehouse distribution activities, including inbound receiving, stocking, inventory control and shipping to maximize efficiency.
* Utilize data analysis skills with tools like Power\-BI and other specialized reporting to monitor supply chain performance metrics and identify areas for process improvement.
* Conduct root cause analysis on warehouse operations and transportation delays to implement effective corrective actions.
* Facilitate cross\-functional communication among warehouse floor operations, planning, freight carriers, and customers to ensure compliance with established SLA.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in a supply chain operations role with strong knowledge of warehouse experience.
* Demonstrated ability in team management, shipping logistics and freight management.
* Proficiency in data collection and analysis, skills in Excel data analysis, and supply chain analytics to support decision\-making.
* Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS), transportation management systems (TMS), inventory control practices, and labor management.
* Excellent communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration and customer service excellence.
* Strong problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on process improvement initiatives within logistics operations.

Join us as a Customer Service Logistics Coordinator to be at the heart of our supply chain excellence! Your expertise will help us deliver outstanding service while continuously enhancing our logistics strategies through innovative thinking and proactive solutions.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Disney Entertainment Television is seeking a Publicity Coordinator to support publicity campaigns and day\-to\-day communications activities across its portfolio of television programming and content. Working closely with publicists, executives, and cross\-functional partners, the Coordinator will provide administrative, project\-management, and campaign support for series, specials, documentaries, movies, and other programming.

  

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, and energized by a fast\-paced, creative environment. This role requires strong written and verbal communication skills, the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and an interest in developing a career in entertainment publicity. The Coordinator will contribute to the planning and execution of publicity campaigns, events, talent activities, press outreach, and departmental operations.

* Maintain publicity\-related materials and information across internal systems, media sites, presentations, and shared departmental resources.
* Assist with purchase orders, invoices, contracts, expenses, budgets, vendor onboarding, and other campaign or departmental processes as needed.
* Participate in campaign brainstorms and contribute ideas for press angles, pitches, events, and promotional opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal partners across marketing, creative, media, social, production, and other business areas.
* Communicate professionally with external partners, including talent, talent representatives, production teams, public relations agencies, vendors, and members of the media.

* Minimum 1 year of related experience in publicity, communications, marketing, entertainment, or a comparable professional environment.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, demanding, and collaborative environment.
* Proactive, resourceful, and solutions\-oriented approach to work.
* Ability to take direction, exercise sound judgment, and adapt as priorities evolve.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Google Workspace, or comparable productivity and presentation tools.
* Familiarity with major social media platforms and current entertainment and pop\-culture trends.
* Ability to provide on\-site support at publicity events, including occasional evening and weekend work.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Minimum 2 years previous publicity or marketing experience at a television network, streaming platform, studio, production company, agency, or related entertainment organization.

 **Education**

jobs.title: Account Manager - Los Angeles-based
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

Counterintuity, a marketing agency dedicated to helping nonprofits achieve their mission, is seeking a highly organized and client\-focused, Los Angeles\-based **Account Manager** to join our agency team. This role requires someone who can balance strategic thinking, relationship management, and campaign execution — serving as the primary liaison between our agency and its clients while ensuring seamless communication, alignment, and delivery across every account.  

Because this role is dedicated entirely to supporting our nonprofit client roster, compensation for this position is benchmarked to nonprofit\-sector marketing and account management roles rather than traditional commercial agency pay scales — reflecting both the mission\-driven nature of the work and the realities of nonprofit client budgets.  

  

**Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities**  

As an Account Manager at our agency, you will be responsible for:* Serving as the **primary point of contact** for clients — keeping them happy, aligned, and confident in our work.
* Managing **select integrated digital marketing campaigns** across content strategy, social media, and search marketing.
* Optimizing **campaign performance** and pushing for the best possible client outcomes.
* Overseeing **timelines, budgets, and deliverables**, and coordinating closely with the production team to keep work on track and on budget.
* Coordinating with the **production team**, assigning and QAing work precisely, and achieving results on time and on budget.
* Identifying and pursuing **growth opportunities** within your accounts.
* Supporting the **Director of Client Services** and staying current on industry trends and best practices.
* Staying informed on **industry trends** and best practices to provide clients with innovative marketing solutions.

**Key Areas of Responsibility and Time Allocation**  

**Client Communication and Strategy (50%)*** Serve as the primary client contact, ensuring a strong relationship and high satisfaction levels.
* Develop and present strategic recommendations to align campaigns with client business goals.
* Proactively manage expectations, addressing challenges and opportunities in real time.

**Campaign Management (30%)*** Oversee project timelines, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring all campaigns are executed efficiently.
* Work closely with internal teams to maintain quality control and alignment on project objectives.
* Monitor campaign performance and recommend optimizations as needed.

**Internal Collaboration (20%)*** Work cross\-functionally with creative, media, and strategy teams to execute client initiatives.
* Maintain strong internal communication, ensuring that all teams are aligned on client expectations.
* Assist in the development of client presentations and reports to showcase campaign results.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)*** **Client Satisfaction \& Retention** – Maintain an 85%\+ client satisfaction and retention rate.
* **Project Execution** – Ensure 95%\+ of projects are completed on time and within budget.
* **Account Growth** – Think strategically, pursue growth opportunities, and grow your personally managed annual book of business by 10%.
* **Campaign Performance** – Improve marketing metrics such as engagement, conversions, and ROI through strategic adjustments.

  

**Required Skills**  

**Hard Skills:*** **3 years of experience** in account management, marketing, or client services within an agency or marketing firm.
* Strong understanding of marketing strategy, campaign execution, and project management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, keeping them on time and within budget.
* Proficiency in marketing analytics, CRM platforms, and project management software.
* Strong business acumen with an ability to identify opportunities for growth within accounts.

**Soft Skills:*** Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Detail\-oriented approach with a problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Collaborative and proactive approach to internal teamwork and client engagement.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and adaptability, with a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with team members.

  

**30\-60\-90 Day Onboarding Plan**  

**First 30 Days:*** Learn agency processes, tools, and workflows.
* Review existing client accounts and gain an understanding of their business goals.
* Meet with internal teams and leadership to establish key working relationships.
* Observe ongoing campaigns and projects to understand execution strategies.

**60 Days:*** Take full ownership of assigned accounts, acting as the lead point of contact.
* Begin managing project timelines, budgets, and deliverables independently.
* Identify potential process improvements for more efficient account management.
* Contribute to client presentations and strategy discussions.

**90 Days:*** Identify and present opportunities for account growth, such as additional services or expanded scope.
* Lead client meetings, providing strategic insights and recommendations.
* Establish long\-term success strategies for assigned accounts to improve retention and performance.
* Set personal and professional development goals to enhance skills in account management.

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**  

This role requires a highly organized and client\-focused professional who can balance strategic thinking, relationship management, and campaign execution. The ideal Account Manager is a strong communicator, proactive problem solver, and detail\-oriented project manager who thrives in a fast\-paced, client\-driven environment. They must be comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously, working cross\-functionally with internal teams, and identifying growth opportunities within accounts.  

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a motivated **B2B Sales \& Business Development Representative** to help expand our U.S. sales channels for innovative consumer electronics, mobile accessories, and wireless connectivity solutions.

This is **not a call center or traditional customer service position**.

The primary focus of this role is to identify new business opportunities, develop relationships with distributors, retailers, resellers, and corporate customers, and turn those relationships into revenue.

You will work with two growing businesses bringing Japanese technology products and wireless solutions to the U.S. market.

Our product portfolio includes:

* Mobile batteries and charging accessories
* Consumer electronics and mobile accessories
* Wireless connectivity products
* eSIM and mobile data solutions
* 5G Wi\-Fi and connectivity solutions for businesses and events

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys **building relationships, opening new accounts, and developing new markets** rather than simply managing existing customers.

Key Responsibilities

* Prospect and develop new B2B customers in the U.S.
* Identify potential distributors, retailers, resellers, dealers, and corporate accounts
* Conduct outbound sales outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, and in\-person meetings
* Build and manage a pipeline of qualified sales opportunities
* Present products and business solutions to prospective customers
* Develop relationships with distributors and channel partners
* Follow up on leads and convert opportunities into active accounts
* Prepare proposals, quotations, and basic sales presentations
* Maintain accurate sales activity and opportunity records
* Attend trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings as needed
* Work directly with management to develop new sales channels and go\-to\-market opportunities
* Support new product launches and expansion of Japanese technology products into the U.S. market

Who We're Looking For

We are especially interested in candidates who are **comfortable creating new business rather than waiting for inbound leads**.

Ideal candidates may have experience in one or more of the following areas:

* B2B sales
* Business development
* Account management
* Consumer electronics
* Mobile accessories
* Wireless / telecom
* Electronics distribution
* Retail or dealer sales
* IT or technology solutions

Qualifications

* 2\+ years of B2B sales, business development, or account management experience preferred
* Demonstrated ability to prospect and develop new customer relationships
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable making outbound calls and contacting prospective customers
* Ability to manage a sales pipeline independently
* Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM systems
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment
* Ability to meet customers in Southern California and attend industry events when required

Experience selling through **distributors, retailers, resellers, wireless dealers, or corporate accounts** is highly desirable.

Experience in consumer electronics, telecom, wireless, mobile accessories, or technology products is a strong plus.

Language

Fluent English is required.

Japanese, Spanish, Korean, or Chinese language skills are a plus, but not required.

What Success Looks Like

During your first several months, you will be expected to:

* Build a pipeline of qualified B2B prospects
* Establish relationships with new distributors, retailers, and corporate customers
* Open new accounts
* Generate recurring sales opportunities
* Help identify new channels and market opportunities for our products

We are looking for someone who wants to **build a market and grow with the business**, not simply process incoming orders.

Work Environment

Hybrid position based in Gardena, California.

The role includes a combination of remote work, office collaboration, customer meetings, and occasional trade shows or industry events.

Compensation

**Base Salary: $40,000–$70,000 per year, on experience**

**Plus sales commission / performance incentives**

Final compensation will depend on relevant experience and demonstrated sales capabilities.

Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gardena, CA 90248

We use graphics, photography, social media, email marketing, personalized messaging, and storytelling to showcase who we are as a church community and, through it, impact the community and world around us.



This position is the connective tissue of our team. Are you the person who sees the whole board, keeps a dozen moving pieces on schedule, and writes well while doing it?



Saddleback Church is looking for a Marketing Coordinator who loves bringing order to creative work so that what our church says on any given weekend is clear, on time, and on mission.

**WEEKEND COMMUNICATIONS COORDINATION**


* Write weekend host scripts and announcement copy, tailored to the host and aligned with established on\-camera conventions and the Saddleback voice.

* Support Church News: gather and prioritize announcement content, prepare and route drafts, and coordinate revisions with the host, video producer, and Marketing Director.
* Serve as the weekend point of contact for communications questions and be present at weekends and key events as required.


**COMMUNICATION CALENDAR MANAGEMENT**

Partners4Wellness (P4W) seeks a compassionate and motivated **Outreach Coordinator** to facilitate life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth involved in the juvenile justice system. Life Skills and Resiliency Workshops

At 454 Creative, we are all about growth! We see it as our mission to come alongside SMBs, credit unions, universities, and non\-profits with digital marketing and sales expertise to help them grow. The Account Manager acts as a liaison between 454 Creative and our clients, setting digital strategies that align with our client’s goals, nurturing clients through the agency processes and ensuring they are satisfied with our services and creative outcomes. This job is a good fit for someone who is both strategic and relational, loves building bridges with others as a part of a team, and is an effective communicator.

Here is a quick snapshot of some of the responsibilities of the Account Manager

**ACCOUNT BRAND STRATEGY**

* Translate the scope of work/proposal and the needs of the clients into a cohesive, actionable, strategic plan with specific tactics, often known as a 3 Month Tactical Plans (3MTPs).
* Complete Lean Marketing Framework sprints by working with the team to develop Brand Messaging, Digital Marketing Analysis (DMA), Customer Journey Funnel and 3MTP.
* Work with the Client to outline key objectives, desired outcomes and KPIs for the relationship.
* Host and lead all meetings with the client, pulling in appropriate 454 Creative Team Members and creating a prepared agenda to be sent out in advance to all participants.
* Review monthly reports from Digital Marketing Team before sending to client and work with the team to make recommendations as needed.
* Develop required content for emails, digital ads, lead magnets and other written pieces as needed.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About Acrisure**


A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting\-edge technology and top\-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services – and more.  



In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries. Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible.

  



**About The Role**


The Commercial Lines Large Account Manager will have a primary responsibility for policy maintenance and service of an assigned portion of accounts. Maintain a high level of client retention by managing the day\-to\-day service needs of our clients and constantly work toward strong client relationships. Market and service accounts in accordance with the platform objectives and procedures. Contribute to the profitable growth of the platform by achieving retention and renewal goals, proactive account rounding, up\-selling of limits/coverages and by providing extraordinary client service.

 **Responsibilities:**


* Establish and maintains a strong relationship and assists the client advisors in making decisions on account updates and coverage for accounts ranging from mid\-size to large accounts with moderate complexities.
* Collaborate with the client advisor to review exposures and insurance programs for assigned clients, determine if carrier is the best fit for the client while considering coverage, protection, and cost.
* Collaborate with client advisors to market, quote, and prepare the proposal for the client from both a risk management and insurance prospective to decide upon the “best” way to manage the customer’s risk.
* Provide day\-to\-day service, anticipate customer’s needs, and respond to client issues/questions in a timely manner.
* Handles initial report of claims and following up to ensure that the claim is properly progressing, and customer’s needs are being met.
* Monitor carrier activities to make sure that they are fulfilling their responsibilities to the customer (policy endorsements, claims, etc.).
* Complete account reviews.
* Attempt to round\-out each customer’s insurance portfolio including, the solicitation of additional commercial and personal lines insurance where applicable and maintain customer records in accordance with procedures.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Yowei Therapeutics and Yowei Oncology are stealth\-stage life\-sciences companies working closely with CSBio to advance peptide\-based clinical programs. Their work spans longevity and peptide therapeutics, clinical trials, evaluation of a 503A pharmacy model, personalized synthetic neoantigen peptide oncology programs, and supporting microbiology and laboratory capabilities. Together, they are building the clinical, pharmacy, data, laboratory, and operational infrastructure needed to responsibly translate peptide programs into patient\-facing studies and services. Both companies expect to remain in stealth through Q1 2027\.


CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993\. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.


Yowei Therapeutics is seeking a detail\-oriented Clinical Research Coordinator to manage day\-to\-day study coordination for early clinical and longevity programs. Core duties are included below.


Job Duties:

* Coordinate study startup, participant screening, scheduling, visits, follow\-up, and closeout activities under investigator and protocol oversight.
* Maintain regulatory, delegation, training, screening, enrollment, visit, specimen, investigational\-product, issue, and action logs as assigned.
* Prepare visit packets and confirm consent, eligibility, orders, supplies, equipment, staff, and vendor readiness before each visit.
* Collect and enter accurate study data from approved sources into EDC, CTMS, electronic source, or other controlled systems; resolve queries promptly.
* Coordinate specimens, laboratories, imaging, pharmacy, vendors, couriers, and chain\-of\-custody requirements.
* Track adverse\-event and deviation documentation and escalate medical or safety issues immediately to qualified personnel; do not make independent clinical decisions.
* Support participant communication, reminders, reimbursement documentation, retention, and approved education materials.
* Support monitoring visits, audits, inspections, document requests, and corrective actions.
* Maintain confidentiality, version control, data quality, and complete records; surface risks and missed deadlines early.
* Prepare concise weekly status reports on enrollment, visits, data completeness, deviations, vendor issues, and decisions needed.
* Collect, process, label, store, and coordinate shipment of clinical specimens when appropriately trained, credentialed, and authorized.

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, health, psychology, public health, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2\+ years of clinical\-research, site\-coordination, patient\-services, or regulated health\-program experience.
* Working knowledge of GCP, informed\-consent documentation, source records, data entry, privacy, and protocol adherence.
* Strong organization, participant communication, documentation, and follow\-through skills.
* Ability to work on site and manage multiple participants, visits, vendors, and deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

* Phlebotomy experience strongly preferred, including venipuncture, specimen labeling, processing, handling, and chain\-of\-custody documentation. A current California phlebotomy certificate or another credential authorizing venipuncture is required if the coordinator will perform blood draws.
* ACRP or SOCRA certification.
* Experience with early\-phase, oncology, metabolic health, longevity, infusion, decentralized, or investigator\-initiated research.
* Experience with EDC, CTMS, eRegulatory, electronic source, specimen tracking, or participant\-engagement systems.

  

**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 85% for Employee and 50% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program
* Company organized social events
* Quarterly sponsored team building activities

jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Community Outreach Coordinator**
----------------------------------


Court Appointed Special Advocates (CASA) of San Mateo County offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to make a real difference in the lives of children and youth involved in foster care and the juvenile justice system. By joining our dynamic team, volunteers build long\-lasting relationships with young people, serving as both trusted mentors and powerful advocates within the courtroom and beyond. At CASA, we recruit, train, and empower dedicated volunteers to work one\-on\-one with youth, building meaningful relationships that help transform futures. Our volunteers are trusted mentors and powerful advocates in court and beyond, offering much\-needed stability for children facing uncertain times.


CASA’s office is in Redwood City, CA.


#### **Position Overview**



As our **Community Outreach Coordinator**, you'll be the face of our mission, sparking connections with prospective volunteers and community organizations to grow the network of volunteers who change young lives. In this outward\-facing, communications, driven role, you'll design and lead an active recruitment strategy that reaches new volunteers both virtually and in person, often serving as the very first impression someone has of our organization. This dynamic position calls for a confident communicator who's energized by public engagement and community building, with some evening and weekend availability to meet volunteers where they are. If you're passionate about relationship\-building and driven to expand our community of changemakers, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


The ideal candidate is bilingual and biliterate in Spanish and English, with exceptional interpersonal and motivational communication skills. They bring experience creating volunteer recruitment materials, are highly organized and detail\-oriented, particularly with paperwork and scheduling, and are comfortable researching, analyzing, and compiling data. Has sound judgment, collaborates well with team members, and can think on their feet. Genuine passion for the organization's mission (volunteers can sense authenticity). Patience and flexibility, since volunteer availability and commitment levels vary widely. Ability to make people feel valued and see the tangible impact of their time


**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager\-Initiative, Training and Recruitment


**Status:** Full \-time, non\-exempt; 40 hours per week with occasional evening and weekend work required


**Location:** Redwood City, CA\- Hybrid work schedule with two days in the office and occasional travel to off\-site locations for presentations and events.


#### **Duties and Responsibilities**


* Build and maintain volunteer pipeline:
* Develop and implement a comprehensive volunteer recruitment plan to recruit a diverse pool of volunteers to serve as Court Appointed Special Advocates based on waitlist needs and current volunteer pool.
* Coordinate organizational efforts to recruit a diverse pool of volunteers to (1\) provide culturally and linguistically sensitive services to the youth CASA supports and to (2\) ensure that the organization has a volunteer pool with individuals with diverse backgrounds.
* Identify and establish relationships and promote volunteer opportunities with local community organizations, corporations, associations, collaborations, and networks that act as natural volunteer recruitment sources.
* Build ongoing relationships with community organizations, businesses, and schools as recurring volunteer pipelines.
* Schedule and coordinate orientations, this includes ensuring information is updated, current, and correct on website and other public documentation and delivery of information.
* Process volunteer applications including entering and verifying information is accurate and complete for each prospective trainee on agency database, tracking prospective trainee information, and identifying and reporting to the Program Team on any issues regarding candidates.
* Collaborate with the Development Team to develop and produce recruitment and outreach materials, including PowerPoints, flyers, banners, and both digital and hard copy collateral, as well as contribute to broader organizational marketing and awareness materials beyond volunteer recruitment. This includes Spanish\-language versions.
* Partner with the Development and Program teams to create social media content that supports both volunteer recruitment and CASA's broader organizational marketing, awareness, and engagement efforts, coordinating translation support as needed.
* Design or coordinate recruitment campaign materials with design/marketing teams when available, ensuring materials support broader outreach efforts.
* Ensure all recruitment and outreach materials reflect a consistent employer brand voice and messaging, in compliance with EEO/equal opportunity language requirements.
* Identify and engage candidates through volunteer pipelines, LinkedIn, referrals, networking events, and databases, including proactive outreach to passive candidates.
* Present to external audiences to recruit volunteers, raise awareness, engage corporate and community partners, and raise the profile of CASA of San Mateo County.
* Plan and host community events and outreach activities that raise awareness of CASA's mission and create multiple pathways for community involvement.
	+ Special events and projects, as required.
* Develop strategies to improve volunteer pipeline from first contact through long\-term service.
* Research and document current recruitment and retention practices.
* Analyze pipeline data to identify where volunteers drop off and manage a defined schedule of touch points that keeps volunteers engaged and tracked at every stage.
* Use outcome and attrition data to identify the highest\-drop\-off phases, especially application and assignment, and to develop targeted strategies to close those gaps.

jobs.description:
**Events \& Operations Specialist**

  

Job Title: Events and Operations Specialist
Department: Strategic Partnerships \& University Relations (SPUR)
Reports to: Vice President for Strategic Partnerships \& University Relations
Location: Residential, In\-Person
Employment Status: Full\-Time Exempt Staff
Salary Range: $60,000 \- $90,000
About Palo Alto University (PAU)


Palo Alto University is a private, nonprofit university dedicated to advancing human understanding through innovative education, groundbreaking research, and impactful practice in behavioral science.


Founded in 1975 and located in the heart of Silicon Valley, PAU offers graduate and undergraduate programs in psychology, counseling, social work, and behavioral science, including the PAU\-Stanford PsyD Consortium with Stanford Medicine. Grounded in human dignity, PAU's scholars, clinicians, educators, and learners share a single conviction: that understanding how people think, feel, behave, relate, heal, and make meaning is among the most essential work of our time.


The university enrolls over 1,200 students, has a network of more than 4,200 alumni, and employs over 150 faculty and staff united by a mission\-driven commitment to advancing human understanding. PAU enters its sixth decade at a defining moment: a new president, a new provost, a bold new vision and strategic plan, and an urgent opportunity to shape how behavioral science responds to the challenges of an increasingly changing world. You will join a mission\-driven community with the ambition to make a measurable impact on the human condition.

  

The Role
Reporting to the Vice President for Strategic Partnerships and University Relations, the Events and Operations Specialist is the production engine of SPUR's advancement event portfolio. This is a new role in a new and growing division, with growth potential as PAU's event calendar matures and expands.


The Specialist produces and executes events with precision, care, and institutional pride. Within SPUR, the functional Director owns the purpose, audience, content, and relationship strategy of every event. The Specialist owns project management, logistics, production, and execution of every event in the portfolio.


The right candidate is energized by complexity, thrives under deadline pressure, takes genuine pride in flawless execution, and understands that in advancement, events cultivate donors, partnerships, relationships, and brand. This is a focused, high\-impact production role at the center of PAU's most consequential external moments.

  

Responsibilities
Event Production and Logistics Management

* Own the end\-to\-end production and logistics of SPUR's core advancement events, including the Annual Gala, President's Circle meetings and dinners, donor and partnership cultivation gatherings, alumni engagement events, and community convenings.
* Manage all event logistics, including venue selection and contracting, catering, audiovisual, signage, transportation, accommodations, staffing, accessibility, and on\-site coordination, ensuring every event is executed seamlessly and reflects PAU's institutional standards.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive event production timelines, run\-of\-show documents, vendor contracts, budget tracking, and post\-event debrief reports for every event in the SPUR portfolio.
* Serve as the primary on\-site coordinator for all advancement events, managing setup, vendor relationships, staff and volunteer coordination, and real\-time problem resolution to ensure every event runs without disruption.
* Build and maintain a preferred vendor network of caterers, venues, audiovisual providers, photographers, printers, and event technology partners that reflects PAU's commitment to quality, value, and mission alignment.


Commencement Week Planning and Execution

* Lead the full production and logistics of PAU's annual commencement week, a multi\-day celebration and advancement cultivation series culminating in the commencement ceremony itself. SPUR owns the planning and full implementation of commencement as an advancement event. The University Registrar and Academic Affairs support degree conferral logistics, student participation lists, and academic ceremony protocol.
* Design and execute a week\-long calendar of cultivation activities, community gatherings, student and family celebrations, donor receptions, and community engagement events that position commencement as PAU's most important annual advancement moment and the first touchpoint of every graduate's alumni life.
* Coordinate with the University Registrar solely on degree conferral logistics, student participation lists, and academic ceremony protocol.
* Own the full commencement event experience, including regalia management, speaker invitations, procession planning, security, media coordination, cultivation programming, and community engagement dimensions of the week.
* Develop commencement week invitation and RSVP management systems for students, families, alumni, donors, partners, faculty, and community guests, ensuring every constituent receives a personalized, timely, and welcoming communication.
* Partner with the Director of Alumni Relations to design cultivation activities during commencement week that introduce graduating students to the alumni community and engage families and parents as prospective donors and institutional advocates.
* Coordinate with the Director of Development to identify and steward donor and prospect touchpoints during commencement week, ensuring high\-priority cultivation relationships receive intentional, personalized engagement throughout the celebration.


Silicon Valley Convenings and Thought Leadership Events

* Once the Director of Strategic Partnerships, VP, or President establishes the strategic objective, target audience, and relationship goals for a convening, own full production from that point forward, translating the strategic vision into a logistically flawless eve

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Decagon**


Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.


Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.


We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.


We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

**About the Role**


We’re looking for a field marketing manager to continue to build out our field marketing function across conferences, events, and executive dinners to drive awareness and pipeline generation. You will help shape the strategy and execution from the field marketing program. The ideal candidate has experience running field events at a fast growing B2B SaaS startup.

**In this role, you will**

* Partner closely with our GTM leadership team to execute on the right portfolio of events to accelerate demand generation pipelines
* Execute on our event strategy ensuring we’re getting in front of the right audience, generating leads, and reaching out to leads in a timely manner
* Extend the Decagon brand across different event formats including conferences, executive dinners, webinars, product launch events, and more
* Define and measure field marketing success through key performance indicators (KPIs) such as ROI, lead generation, pipeline influence, and sales engagement.
* Own the outcome of the leads generated and driving high ROI of our events

**Your background looks something like this**

* 3\-5 years of experience planning and executing and hosting sponsored events
* 1\-2\+ years of field marketing experience with a B2B SaaS / enterprise software startup
* Excellent attention to detail and operational rigor
* The ability to span events across tradeshows, webinar/virtual, and customer dinners
* The ability to span events across awareness (building awareness of Decagon’s brand and getting in front of new leads) and demand generation (driving demos booked)
* Experience and affinity for evolving projects and experiments into repeatable programs
* Outstanding project management skills, the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities, working relationships, cross\-functional partners, and vendors while driving timelines and owning the outcome
* Familiarity with sales processes and systems
* The ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 40%

**Benefits**


We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
* Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
* Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
* Parental Leave
* Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
* Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
* Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

*These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.*


Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator, Organic Content
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Aahana Medical Aesthetics is a new physician\-led medical aesthetics practice opening in Dogpatch in February 2027\. It is founded and run by a board\-certified physician. Small team, high standards, and a real point of view about skin.

**THE** **ROLE**

We are looking for someone to own our organic social media. Instagram and TikTok mainly. You will be the person who captures what happens in the clinic and turns it into something people actually want to watch.

This is a part\-time role and it starts before we open. The first few months are about building an audience from zero, so early content is build\-out progress, education, and behind the scenes as we get the space ready. Once we open, you are in the clinic capturing treatments and results.

**WHAT** **YOU** **WILL** **DO**

\- Plan and run the content calendar for Instagram and TikTok

\- Shoot on site, mostly on an iPhone. Short form video, before and afters, treatment explainers, team moments

\- Edit and post. Captions, hooks, covers, audio

\- Write in our voice. Warm, clear, no hype and no fear\-mongering

\- Reply to comments and direct messages, and pass real enquiries to the front desk

\- Tell us what is working. Saves, shares, watch time, profile visits, not just follower count

\- Coordinate with our paid ads and search agency so organic and paid do not contradict each other

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

\- You have run a social account that grew, and you can show it. A personal account counts

\- You can shoot and edit yourself. CapCut, Instagram Reels or similar

\- You write well and fast

\- You are comfortable on a clinic floor and around patients, and you understand that privacy is not negotiable

\- Interest in skincare, beauty or healthcare. You do not need clinical experience, we will teach you what you need to know

**NICE TO HAVE**

\- Experience in aesthetics, dermatology, beauty or wellness

\- Basic design skills, Canva is fine

\- Comfortable on camera yourself

**ONE THING THAT IS NOT NEGOTIABLE**

Everything we post is governed by patient privacy law. You will be trained on HIPAA, the federal health privacy law, and on California's own medical privacy rules. You will not post a patient photo, name or detail without a signed authorization in hand. Every other part of this job is flexible. That part is not.

**COMPENSATION**

$28 to $35 per hour depending on experience. Roughly 12\-15 hours per week to start, with room to grow as we open.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Email careers@aahanaskin.com with a short note about why this job and links to two or three accounts or posts you made. No cover letter needed. Tell us what you would post in our first month.

Pay: $28\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94107

The Account Management Team plays a key role in supporting HackerRank's growing customer base by partnering with small and mid\-sized businesses as they adopt and scale their technical hiring processes. * Manage a portfolio of Mid Market customers, executing defined adoption and renewal motions to drive retention and customer satisfaction.

US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**

* Establish and lead Technical Governance, focusing on platform health metrics and enterprise readiness planning.

* Serve as the technical advisor to address and resolve critical reliability concerns, advising on and guiding the architecture of highly, scalable, and resilient workloads.

**Salary Range:** $170,000 \- $200,000 depending on experience.


**Position Summary:** This is a full\-time position working within our oncology sales team.

  


**The Opportunity**



We're looking for an experienced and passionate Oncology Account Manager to join our sales team to help drive our mission forward within the oncology space. This is a unique opportunity to be part of something truly meaningful at a pivotal moment in our expansion.



These are foundational roles within our newest therapeutic area, giving you the chance to make a real impact and support patients living with rare hematologic and oncologic conditions.



You'll join a driven and fast\-growing organization with a strong track record within the oncology pharma space. You'll have the opportunity to lead engagement with HCPs and clinics across your territory, educate on disease and treatment pathways, and support access via our specialty pharmacy and/or Cycle Vita patient hub. You'll also collaborate cross\-functionally to help drive launch success and build strong relationships across the haematology/oncology landscape.

We know that life\-changing treatments need life\-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.



At Cycle Pharma, we focus on providing treatments and services for patients with neurological, rare metabolic, and rare immunological conditions, most of which are genetic conditions. Some of our patients are diagnosed with a rare disease at birth, others are affected later in life, and some can spend years trying to get diagnosed. Patient Stories \- Cycle Pharma

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Open Standard**


Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.


Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co\-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1\.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.


Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

**Your role**


As Open Standard’s first Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in bringing the world’s largest banks, payment companies, and fintechs onto the Open USD platform. From the day a partner signs, you will become their main point of contact, guiding them through integration, launch, and every stage of future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with product teams at our founding partners, including Stripe, Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard, whose customers will be among the first to use Open USD.


This is an exciting opportunity to help shape Open Standard’s partner experience, take our earliest partnerships live, and convert a network of signed partners into a community of deeply engaged adopters.

**What you'll do**

* Launch new partners quickly by coordinating across Legal, Product, Compliance, and integration teams, ensuring launches happen in days, not weeks
* Develop tailored growth plans with each partner: define how Open USD fits their business, project transaction volumes for the first year, and identify key success drivers; lead quarterly reviews with partner leadership
* Connect partners within the network to foster collaboration and unlock new value as more companies adopt Open USD
* Serve as the single point of contact for partners after signing: manage launch announcements, handle reporting questions, and involve internal teams (Finance, Legal, Product) as needed
* Own the partner demand picture: build and maintain partner\-level forecasts that guide Liquidity, Finance, and Product planning
* Continuously improve our onboarding and product by turning every partner’s experience into future best practices and enhancements

**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform
* Have worked in a network or marketplace business where facilitating participant connections was part of your role
* Possess enough technical fluency to lead integration calls without needing a dedicated solutions engineer

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform (if not already mentioned above)
* Additional technical expertise to independently own integration conversations

**Logistics**

* **Location:** San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in\-office and remote days

**Come work with us**


Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $210K

**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
