jobs.title: SMB Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**About the Role**
==================


Account Management at Handshake owns **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals, and expansion revenue** across our customer base.


As an **Account Manager, SMB / Mid\-Market**, you'll own the commercial relationship and growth strategy for a portfolio of approximately **75–130 customers**, acting as a strategic commercial owner rather than a contract\-execution renewal rep. You’ll be accountable for retaining and growing revenue while helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with Handshake.


You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Support, Finance, and Legal to develop account strategies, mitigate risk, navigate complex customer needs, and identify opportunities to deepen and expand customer relationships.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic account management, consultative selling, customer advocacy, and operational rigor**. You’ll manage customers at different stages of their lifecycle and prioritize your time based on retention risk, expansion potential, and overall business impact.

* Own commercial strategy across a portfolio of approximately 75–130 SMB and/or Mid\-Market customers, with accountability for GRR, NRR, renewals, and expansion performance
* Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify customer priorities, business outcomes, retention risks, expansion opportunities, and paths to long\-term growth
* Proactively manage the renewal lifecycle from early strategy and stakeholder alignment through negotiation and close
* Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, packaging, contract terms, multi\-year agreements, and complex renewal scenarios
* Identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities across additional licenses, products, and multi\-product offerings to increase NRR
* Build multi\-threaded relationships with champions, decision\-makers, and executive stakeholders to reduce churn risk and unlock growth
* Partner closely with Customer Success to connect product adoption and demonstrated customer value to renewal and expansion strategies
* Lead strategic customer conversations focused on business priorities, ROI, future needs, and opportunities to expand the partnership
* Proactively identify accounts at risk and develop clear retention and mitigation strategies in partnership with internal stakeholders
* Navigate complex customer situations—including competitive evaluations, budget pressure, organizational changes, product concerns, and procurement—with sound commercial judgment and customer empathy
* Maintain a clear understanding of portfolio health, including renewal status, expansion pipeline, account risk, stakeholder engagement, and growth potential
* Own accurate and timely forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity hygiene across revenue systems
* Prioritize your portfolio effectively, balancing high\-touch strategic engagement with scalable account management motions
* Surface customer insights and trends to Product, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership to help improve our product and go\-to\-market strategy
* Contribute to the continued evolution of Account Management by sharing best practices and identifying opportunities to improve processes, playbooks, segmentation, automation, and operating rhythms

  

**Desired Capabilities**
========================

* 2\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, or another customer\-facing B2B SaaS role
* 1\+ years owning commercial outcomes such as renewals, expansion, upsell, cross\-sell, or revenue retention
* Track record managing and growing a portfolio of B2B SaaS customers and associated ARR
* Proven ability to lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through negotiation and close
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives
* Experience identifying customer risk and developing strategies to protect and improve retention
* Experience managing pipeline and producing accurate forecasts against retention and/or expansion targets
* Ability to build credibility and influence across multiple levels of a customer organization, including senior stakeholders and decision\-makers
* Strong prioritization and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer opportunities and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to navigate strategic, commercial, and difficult customer conversations
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Finance, Legal, and RevOps

  

***Extra Credit***
==================

* Experience managing SMB and/or Mid\-Market SaaS customers with responsibility for both retention and expansion
* Experience carrying a renewal, expansion, or revenue quota and con

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Martindale\-Avvo Leads Division is seeking a sales‑oriented, consultative Account Manager to retain and grow a book of \~200 legal clients. You will act as a trusted advisor, onboard new clients for long‑term success, run data‑driven performance reviews, and drive revenue through strategic upsells while proactively minimizing churn.
Key responsibilities:* Own a portfolio of \~200 law‑firm and legal‑service clients, building strong, long‑term relationships.
* Onboard new clients: set up accounts, establish goals, and ensure successful adoption of products/services.
* Conduct regular, data\-driven performance reviews, leveraging AI\-assisted insights where appropriate to measure ROI, identify opportunities, and recommend optimizations.
* Drive revenue growth through consultative upselling and cross‑selling of relevant Martindale‑Avvo solutions.
* Proactively monitor client health signals and intervene to prevent churn.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Marketing to escalate issues, share feedback, and improve the client experience.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM and prepare clear reporting for leadership.


What success looks like:* Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to translate data into clear, actionable insights.
* Measurable upsell/cross‑sell revenue and growth in client lifetime value.
* Strong client satisfaction and adoption metrics (NPS, product usage, goal attainment).
* Consistent, timely delivery of performance reviews and action plans.


Qualifications:* Understand the use of AI tools to work more efficiently, identify account opportunities faster, and spend more time on high\-value client interactions.
* 3\+ years in account management, client success, or consultative sales—experience with legal industry clients strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a portfolio of accounts.
* Comfortable with numbers and using data to drive recommendations.
* Strong problem‑solving skills and a proactive, client‑first mentality.
* Organized, self‑directed, and able to prioritize across a large book of business.


Nice to have* Familiarity with Martindale‑Avvo products or similar legal marketing platforms
* Experience with Salesforce (or similar CRM) and email tools such as Outreach

At Internet Brands, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the rate for this role to be at $21\.64/hourly plus commission and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.  

  

In addition to our awesome culture, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health and well\-being of you and your family. Our benefits include health insurance options such as medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for medical and dependent care, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, and life and AD\&D insurance. We also provide a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, commuter benefits as well as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and well\-being coaching services. In addition, employees can take advantage of voluntary benefits such as home, auto and pet insurance, and discounted legal and financial services. For more details, feel free to inquire during the interview process.  

  

Internet Brands®, headquartered in El Segundo, Calif, is a fully integrated online media and software services company focused on four high\-value vertical categories: Health, Automotive, Legal, and Home/Travel. The company's properties and platforms include the WebMD, Medscape, and Henry Schein ONE networks, which are the global leaders in their markets; Nolo, Avvo, and Martindale, which form the largest consumer information provider in the legal market; and CarsDirect, Fodor's Travel, and many others which are leaders in their key vertical markets. Internet Brands' award\-winning consumer websites lead their categories and serve more than 250 million monthly visitors, while a full range of web presence offerings has established deep, long\-term relationships with SMB and enterprise clients. The company's powerful, proprietary operating platform provides the flexibility and scalability to fuel the company's continued growth. Internet Brands is a portfolio company of KKR and Warburg Pincus.  

  

Internet Brands is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance (FCIHO).

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.



Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one\-of\-a\-kind vibrancy into our culture.



If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.


As a Customer Success Manager in our Enterprise team you will be part of a team managing some of the world's biggest and most recognizable brands.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Be your customers' main point of contact and trusted advisor at Braze

* Drive customer advocacy by building strong customer relationships and creating mutual value for your customers and Braze
* Proactively analyze your customer product usage to identify opportunities and risks to account health

* Advocate for your customers, soliciting and synthesizing customer product feedback to contribute to product development
* Provide continuing education for customers to maximize product usage, identifying new or unused Braze features that could provide value for your customer and represent an upsell opportunity for Braze.
* In addition to being a dedicated contact for strategy, product training inquiries, and non\-technical support, you will coordinate with other Braze teams including Technical Support, Industry Solutions, and Deliverability Services to ensure your customers receive the support they need simply and seamlessly
* Work with Onboarding Managers and other Customer Success Partners to seamlessly transition clients from onboarding to ongoing activity.
* You will likely spend time onsite with customers and may travel \[internationally]


Please note this job description cannot possibly cover every duty you may need to undertake, you may be asked by your line manager to handle other reasonable responsibilities commensurate with the role.


**WHO YOU ARE**



You are passionate about customer success and find satisfaction in helping your customers achieve great things. You have a proven track record in customer success and are seeking to progress your career, with one of the industry's most advanced customer success teams, by working with established, household\-name, enterprise customers with over 1,000 employees.


* You are an excellent communicator with exemplary written and verbal communication skills coupled with unparalleled follow up skills. Clients and colleagues have the impression that you listen and understand the strategic problems they are trying to solve
* You're excited by working with medium and large technology companies who move fast, and want to build new customer experiences quickly
* You're known for being a "team player." We just can't emphasize this enough
* You build great relationships with colleagues and customers
* You have a high level of intellectual curiosity. You see opportunity and growth in learning more about what you do and how it impacts others
* You have experience successfully managing complex accounts or projects with sophisticated clients, multiple stakeholders, and competing priorities
* You have excellent time management skills
* You have domain knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, APIs, Marketing Automation, Direct Marketing, Marketing Analytics or Programming (HTML etc
* 2\-5 years relevant experience in a related area, for example Onboarding, Customer Success, Implementations or Project Management


For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $94,620 \- $102,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $114,275 \- $120,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, Braze offers full and part\-time employees a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that all Braze employees own a piece of our company.


**WHAT WE OFFER**


*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*



From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work\-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Aware Health is a virtual\-first musculoskeletal (MSK) care and lifestyle medicine company helping self\-funded employers reduce healthcare costs and improve outcomes for their members.

The Customer Success Manager will own a portfolio of accounts end\-to\-end, driving implementation, engagement, ROI, retention, and expansion. You'll serve as the primary relationship holder for your accounts, managing the employer, the broker, and the member experience simultaneously.

This is not an entry\-level role. We're looking for someone who comes in ready to own their book, communicate with confidence in the language of employee benefits and self\-funded health plans, and hit the ground running with minimal ramp time. If you've worked in health tech, employee benefits, a TPA, or a benefits consulting firm and you're looking to make the leap to a high\-growth startup, we want to talk with you.

This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco Financial District office, with required in\-office days Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Remote work is not available for this position

**What You'll Be Measured On**

* **Member Engagement:** Drive each account to at least 20% engagement, with an average of 25%\+ across your book. You'll get there through targeted digital campaigns, HR coordination, onsite visits, and creative outreach strategies.
* **Customer ROI:** Aware Health puts its fees at risk. You'll own the ROI model for each account and be responsible for delivering on it.
* **Net Revenue Retention (NRR):** Your goal is 100% NRR, retaining existing revenue and identifying expansion opportunities within your book.

**What You'll Own**

**Account Management \& Retention**

* Build deep, trusted relationships with employers and brokers; serve as their go\-to on all things Aware Health
* Maintain current account plans for every customer, clearly documenting health, risks, open commitments, and renewal timelines
* Lead renewals independently, with support from leadership on complex situations
* Partner with the analytics team to analyze claims data, utilization, engagement, and cost containment metrics, and translate those into clear, compelling QBR narratives
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and advance those conversations in partnership with the sales team

**Member Engagement \& Marketing**

* Design and execute integrated marketing campaigns to drive member activation and ongoing engagement
* Coordinate with HR contacts to create awareness and incentive programs that move the needle
* Collaborate with clinical to manage scheduling waves and balance provider bandwidth

**Implementation**

* Act as project manager for new account launches, bringing together data, billing, marketing, and onboarding
* Set customers up for success from day one and capture satisfaction feedback before the first QBR

**Voice of the Customer**

* Capture and surface member and employer feedback to inform product and clinical roadmaps
* Contribute to CS process improvements across onboarding, QBRs, and marketing workflows

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 4\+ years in a Customer Success or Account Management role
* Background in one or more of the following: health tech, employee benefits, self\-funded health plans, MSK/physical therapy, digital health, TPA, or benefits consulting
* Familiarity with how self\-funded employer health plans work, including broker relationships, plan design, and cost containment strategies
* Demonstrated ability to read and communicate using claims data, utilization metrics, or healthcare cost analysis
* Proven track record of retention and growth across a book of business
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Comfort operating in a fast\-moving, startup environment where the playbook is still being written
* Self\-starter who drives their own learning and doesn't wait to be told what to do

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience working directly with employee benefits brokers or consultants
* Familiarity with B2B2E (business\-to\-business\-to\-employee) models
* HubSpot experience
* Background in MSK health, physical therapy, or virtual care platforms

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Early equity stake

* FSA administration

* 401K

Digital Transformation gave rise to a $600B consulting Industry. AI Transformation will be 10x bigger and will be delivered through agents. We built that.


Our AI discovers how work actually happens across every team and application, Structures it into a living Context Graph, and Improves it continuously.


ServiceNow mapped 900\+ processes in 9 days. DoorDash captured 3,800\+ finance operations in 14 weeks. That's not a project. That's compounding intelligence.


OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Within to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT\-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch.


We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.

This is the first dedicated business development role on our Enterprise team, and one of the first at Within. Our Account Executives currently prospect their own patches, which is the single biggest constraint on how fast we add new enterprise logos. You'll take that on: running outbound across a defined book of Enterprise AEs instead of owning a patch of your own.


Your territory: companies with $500M\+ in revenue in software, professional services, financial services, healthcare and manufacturing. Your job is coverage and speed \- finding accounts the moment they become winnable, reaching the right person first, and building net\-new pipeline across multiple patches rather than going deep on a handful of logos.


You'll have Salesforce, Hubspot, Gong, Clay, Sales Navigator, a documented ICP and sales process, and proof points that already get people to lean in. Your job is to turn that into a real outbound motion for sustained revenue growth.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain the target account list across the Enterprise segment, against a $500M\+ revenue floor. Know which accounts are live, which are parked, and why.
* Track the signals that predict a deal: an active or imminent ERP, CRM or HRIS migration (S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday, Salesforce), post\-M\&A integration, a new transformation mandate, or a new Finance or Transformation executive in their first 180 days.
* Reach out proactively to senior executives across Technology and Transformation, plus GTM, IT and Finance. Internal Audit and Compliance isn't a viable entry point on its own.
* Source the process excellence and operations managers who don't hold budget but convert 3\-5x better than broad campaigns, and fill our Change Agent Bootcamps.
* Write outreach a CFO actually reads. Close to half of won deals compete against doing nothing, not another vendor.
* Qualify every meeting to a real bar: confirmed authority, confirmed need, an identified use case, and a discovery call booked with the AE.
* Run account planning with our Enterprise AEs and keep handoffs clean.
* Help build the function: choose the sequencer, set the cadence, write the objection handling, and feed what's working back to the team.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You…**

* Have 4\+ years of professional experience, including 2\+ years in an SDR, BDR or inside sales role selling SaaS or AI solutions, with a quota you've consistently beaten.
* Have prospected into $500M\+ enterprise accounts and can hold structure across hundreds of accounts and multiple AEs at once.
* Are comfortable opening conversations with CFOs, CIOs and VPs of Transformation, in writing and on the phone.
* Do the research. Personalization means knowing a company is eighteen months into a stalled Oracle Fusion program, not swapping in a company name.
* Write short, specific, no\-filler copy.
* Use AI daily in your own workflow, not just talk about using it.
* Are fluent in Salesforce and modern prospecting tools.

**Strong Candidates May Also…**

* Have sold into finance, transformation, process excellence or shared services organizations.
* Have built an outbound motion from scratch, or rebuilt one.
* Be adept at Apollo, Gong, Sales Navigator, Salesforce or similar tools.
* Use LLMs like Claude/ChatGPT/Grok as part of your daily workflow

**What Within Values in This Hire**


We’re not just hiring a title. We’re hiring a builder. Here’s what matters to us:

* **History of Achievement**: You have a track record of setting ambitious goals and hitting them. Quota attainment isn’t a hope \- it’s a habit.
* **Intellectually Curious**: You learn everything about your customers, their industry, and the product \- then use that knowledge to delight prospects and win trust.
* **Appetite for Closing**: Passionate about winning. Comfortable asking people to make decisions right now. You drive urgency without creating pressure.
* **Coachable**: You have the desire and ability to take feedback, internalize it, and get measurably better \- fast.
* **Scrappy Builder**: Proven track record of building, not just managing. Hungry for the next level and willing to do the unglamorous work to get there.
* **AI Fluent**: You possess a deep understanding and proven track record of using a variety of AI tools across all aspects of the sales process \- from discovery to ROI to close. You use AI to sharpen prospecting, manage your time, stay organized, and prioritize your day to maximize results. Building your own Agents and Skills is a plus.
* **Loyalty \& Resilience**: Commitment to prior employers. We want people who dig in when things get hard, not people who optimize for optionality.
* **Customer Obsessed**: Entrepreneurial spirit, strong opinions, bias for action. Cares deeply about customer outcomes.
* **Technical Translator**: Can make the complex feel simple. Moves fluidly between deep technical conversations and business\-value story telling

 **Location \& Travel**


This role is based in San Francisco, in the office four days a week under our standard in\-office policy. Outreach happens by email and phone from a desk, with no customer travel neccessary.

**Benefits:**
----------

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (SF)
jobs.description:
**About Sequel**
----------------


Every company is becoming a media company. The problem is that most of them are building their audience on someone else's platform, and handing their best data to it.


Sequel fixes that. We power webinars, virtual events, and video programs that live directly on a company's own website, so every registration, view, question, and click becomes first\-party data they own. Then we put that data to work. With our new AI agents, Sequel helps marketing teams create programs faster, turn engaged viewers into pipeline, and grow their audience without adding headcount.

  

We call it \- **Human Moments, Agentic Momentum.**

  

We're trusted by 300\+ customers, some of the world's fastest growing companies like Cisco, Zoominfo, Clay, ElevenLabs, Newsweek, etc. are building their audience with Sequel. We've kept zero churn among our mid market \& enterprise customers, and we've tripled our growth multiple times. We're VC\-backed and recently closed a new round of funding to double down on AI and scale the team.

  

**BDR @ Sequel.io \- SF Hub**
-----------------------------


The Business Development Representative (BDR) plays a critical role in Sequel's go\-to\-market engine, generating qualified pipeline for the sales team through outbound prospecting, warmbound lead activation, field events, and warm introductions. The BDR is often the first human touchpoint for prospects, helping them understand Sequel's value and guiding them toward a well\-qualified demo with our Account Executives.


We already have two BDRs on the team and we're growing. One of our BDRs is now transitioning into an Account Executive role after crushing goals for 18 months.


We're looking for someone who is hungry, energized by our pace of growth, obsessed with hitting targets, and constantly learning. This role requires an experimentation mindset and the willingness to persevere through rejection, paired with the ability to build rapport fast, over the phone, over email, or in person, with buyers who start out skeptical because they don't want to be sold to.


You don't need a lot of prior experience, but you do need to learn quickly and be enthusiastic about building systems with AI. You'll join an existing team that's performing and hitting quota, working hard but having fun, with real opportunities for internal advancement.

  

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Outbound prospecting across cold calling, cold email, LinkedIn outreach, social selling, and multi\-threading into target accounts
* Research on accounts and contacts to craft targeted sequences aligned to buyer personas (Marketing, Demand Gen, MOps)
* Warm introductions sourced from Sequel executives, investors, and partners, converted into qualified conversations
* Warmbound lead activation: demo requests, webinar attendees, content downloads, and website engagement signals, qualified using SPICED\-aligned discovery
* No\-show and warmbound re\-engagement through structured call, email, and occasional SMS workflows
* Representing Sequel at industry events and trade shows, prospecting on\-site and soliciting product demos
* Demo scheduling and handoff to Account Executives, with clean SPICED discovery notes and CRM hygiene
* Pipeline generation and reporting against weekly and monthly demo booking targets
* Experimentation across messaging, cadences, subject lines, and channels, including AI\-assisted testing to improve cold call and cold email results, with learnings documented for the team

  

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Hunger to hit and exceed targets, energized rather than daunted by a fast\-growing, fast\-changing company
* Natural rapport\-builder who can earn trust quickly with skeptical buyers, by phone, email, or in person
* High curiosity about the product itself, with a willingness to dig in and learn how Sequel compares to competitors in a crowded market
* Comfort with experimentation and the resilience to keep going through rejection
* Genuine interest in using AI tools day to day and learning new ones as they emerge
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Little to no prior experience required, but a fast learner who takes coaching well

**Why join us \+ Perks:**
-------------------------

* **Real ownership from day one.** This is a high\-impact role where your work ships, customers feel it, and no two days look the same.
* **Remote\-first, with hubs in New York and San Francisco.** We run on strong async communication and a collaborative, low\-ego team. Work from anywhere, connect in person at our NY and SF hubs, and join us for our annual team offsite (this year we were in Barcelona!), kick\-offs, and weekly virtual hang\-outs.
* **A seat at the table.** Everyone has a voice here. We actively ask for feedback and act on it.
* **Built to be AI\-native.** You'll work with the best AI tools and learn how to use them to do the best work of your career.
* **Comprehensive benefits.** Health, dental, vision, 401(k), parental leave, and a generous fitness stipend. Gotta stay healthy \- mind and body!
* **Generous time off.** 20 days of PTO a year, plus a winter company shutdown so the whole team can fully recharge, and extra days off for the special moments in your life, like your birthday.
* **Room to grow.** A clear path for growth and development across the company, with leaders who invest in your career.

  

Compensation Range: $80K \- $120K

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Stable**
----------------


Our mission is to make it simple to headquarter any business on the internet. Today, we provide companies with a business address and a dashboard to manage their physical mail online. Over 15,000\+ companies like Brex, Doordash, and Gusto use Stable to automate their mailroom and act as their permanent business address with the IRS, state, and vendors.


The rules that regulate US entities were written in the 1800s. Stable abstracts these antiquated requirements with tools that empower modern companies to move forward faster.


These rules don't make sense for the way we work today — work takes place in the cloud and businesses are no longer tied to physical proximity or geography.


We’re on a mission to fix the broken system of entity management. Starting with business addresses and mail, we’re abstracting the complex, archaic systems that make company\-building painful and turning them into delightful experiences — so that modern businesses have the tools they need to move forward faster.


We're backed by leading Silicon Valley investors like Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Shakti, Hustle Fund, and founders from companies like Lattice, Apartment List, and FlexJobs.


Our business is at an inflection point. We’re growing quickly with a product people love and we’ve proven we can service companies of all stages and industries — from early\-stage startups to publicly traded companies in industries like technology, logistics, and property management.


This is an opportunity to join an early\-stage startup as one of the first employees and do work that directly impacts the future of how companies are built.

**Role**
--------


Stable services companies from newly incorporated sole\-proprietorships all the way to the S\&P 500, and we are hiring a **Sales Development Representative** to proactively engage with high\-value prospects and drive new business. This is an exciting opportunity to grow Stable’s pipeline while helping new customers streamline their operations.

**As an SDR**, you will identify, research, and engage with potential customers who could benefit from Stable’s solutions. Your role will be critical in driving awareness, generating leads, and building the foundation for Stable’s sales success.

* **Be a proactive partner for outbound prospects** — Instead of waiting for customers to come to us, you’ll use a mix of personalized outreach and automated tools to spark meaningful conversations with prospects, understanding their pain points and positioning Stable as the best solution for their needs.
* **Identify customer challenges and connect them with the right solutions** — You’ll uncover prospects’ operational challenges and business needs, qualifying opportunities to pass along to the Sales team.
* **Build and refine outbound processes** — Customers from all sorts of industries need a mail solution. You’ll work to identify the best personas, messaging, and channels for outbound outreach, developing scalable processes and playbooks to optimize the outbound sales function.
* **Apply Creative Approaches to Prospect Engagement** – Leverage innovative strategies to connect with prospects, using personalized messaging, thoughtful outreach, and unique tactics to stand out in a crowded market. From crafting engaging email campaigns to exploring unconventional touchpoints, you’ll find ways to capture attention and build meaningful relationships with potential customers.


This is an opportunity to join an early\-stage startup as one of the first employees and have a direct impact on the future of how companies manage mail operations.

  

### **What you value**

* **Be human:** Lead with empathy, act with authenticity, and enjoy what you do.
* **Stay curious:** Invent novel solutions by asking why, listening, and tinkering.
* **Act quickly with purpose:** Focus on what matters, iteratively improve, and move urgently toward the goal.
* **Insist on exceptional outcomes:** Strive for excellence and take ownership of the outcomes you deliver.
* **Exceed customer expectations:** Create delightful experiences with each interaction.

  

### **What you'll do**

* Make a great first impression with customers by crafting compelling outbound emails, calls, and social messages to generate interest in Stable’s products.
* Conduct detailed research to identify and prioritize high\-potential target accounts and decision\-makers.
* Qualify outbound leads by understanding their needs, challenges, and fit for Stable’s solutions.
* Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to align outreach strategies and improve pipeline generation.
* Experiment in identifying the best personas and channels for engaging with new customers and refine processes to maximize outbound effectiveness.

  

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Sales, Business Development, Account Management, or a related field.
* 0\-1 year of experience with a preference for candidates that have expressed interest in sales or business development either professionally or during university
* Proven ability to conduct thoughtful and personalized outreach across email, phone, and social channels.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
* Comfortable working within a fast\-paced, scaling sales environment.

  

### **What we offer**

* Competitive salary and generous equity
* Unlimited paid vacation
* Healthcare benefits
* Home office set\-up
* Work from anywhere within US time zones (GMT\-5 to GMT\-10\)
* Opportunities to shape the future of Stable and grow into leadership roles

For more than 60 years, the Ackerman Institute for the Family has been at the forefront of family systems therapy—advancing how families understand themselves, heal together, and build resilience across generations. Through our integrated model of clinical services, professional training, and applied research, we serve thousands of New York families each year and train the next generation of therapists nationwide.

Family systems therapy is a distinctive niche: it draws donors, clinicians, and researchers who believe the family unit is the most powerful lever for mental health and social change. jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**


It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**


Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill\-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well\-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self\-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD\-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in\-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person\-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20\.17/hour (after probation) \+ Industry\-Leading Benefits for all full\-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.


ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

jobs.description:
CLIENT SERVICES COORDINATOR  
Shine Foundation

Reports to: Director of Operations \& Community Engagement  
Schedule: Full time, M\-F, with flexibility for alternating weeks Sun\- Thurs; onsite  
Salary: $55,000–$60,000 annually, based on experience

ABOUT SHINE FOUNDATION

The Shine Foundation is a Jewish nonprofit organization that serves women and families of every background, faith, and identity. Guided by the belief that every person deserves dignity, compassion, and care, our flagship program provides widows, survivors of domestic violence, and their families with complimentary new clothing, shoes, accessories, and household essentials in a warm, boutique\-style showroom. Our work helps women restart their lives after widowhood and other life\-altering circumstances through personal attention and an experience centered on dignity and choice.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Client Services Coordinator ensures each Shine client receives organized, responsive, and highly personal support. The role manages client and referral inquiries, appointment scheduling, transportation and donation logistics, showroom preparation, service records, and follow\-up. It also maintains the inventory, systems, volunteer support, and physical readiness required for client appointments and assists with related programs, events, and communications content.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working directly with people while keeping schedules, information, donated goods, and logistics organized behind the scenes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Services and Appointment Coordination

* Respond promptly and professionally to client and referral\-partner inquiries.
* Schedule new and returning clients and manage confirmations, reminders, cancellations, rescheduling, and follow\-up.
* Coordinate client transportation and driver schedules when needed.
* Maintain accurate client and appointment records, including visit needs, referral sources, transportation, cancellations, items distributed, and follow\-up.
* Prepare the showroom, donated goods, and supporting materials before appointments.
* Serve as the primary onsite coordinator during client visits, providing a discreet, respectful, and highly personal experience.
* Protect client privacy and escalate sensitive or complex matters to the Director.

Showroom, Inventory, and Service Systems

* Maintain an organized, welcoming, and appropriately stocked showroom by receiving, categorizing, labeling, storing, restocking, and tracking donated goods.
* Coordinate the pickup, delivery, receiving, and internal movement of approved product donations.
* Maintain accurate InFlow records, including item category, quantity, size, season, value, and location, and support inventory counts and reconciliations.
* Record donated goods distributed through client appointments and programs.
* Maintain organized storage areas and identify inventory shortages, location issues, or facilities concerns that could affect client service.
* Maintain relevant files, trackers, checklists, and procedures, and help improve recurring service workflows.

Volunteer, Program, and Event Support

* Coordinate volunteer onboarding, scheduling, assignments, communications, and records.
* Train and supervise volunteers during onsite activities and track their hours and completed work.
* Support client programs and events through participant communications, registration, supplies, volunteer coordination, room preparation, setup, breakdown, and onsite logistics.
* Ensure activities reflect Shine’s standards for confidentiality, client dignity, presentation, and service, and restore the space afterward.

Content and File Support

* Capture and organize approved photographs, videos, templates, program materials, and other digital assets in the appropriate shared files.
* Draft light\-touch social media and newsletter content as assigned, using approved messaging and protecting client confidentiality.
* Obtain and maintain required photo, video, and testimonial permissions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
* At least two years of relevant experience involving client service, appointments, scheduling, records, events, retail, hospitality, nonprofit programs, or related coordination.
* Strong organizational, written, verbal, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Warm, professional, and service\-oriented, with sound judgment, discretion, and sensitivity when working with clients.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning inventory, scheduling, CRM, file\-sharing, and service\-management systems.
* Reliable availability for the Sunday\-through\-Thursday schedule and occasional evening, Friday, Saturday, or additional weekend responsibilities.
* Ability to work actively throughout the showroom and storage areas and assist with light event setup and movement of donated goods. Onsite support is available for heavy lifting.

Shine Foundation is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available during the application process and employment.

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

* Paid time off

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Open Standard**


Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.


Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co\-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1\.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.


Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

**Your role**


As Open Standard’s first Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in bringing the world’s largest banks, payment companies, and fintechs onto the Open USD platform. From the day a partner signs, you will become their main point of contact, guiding them through integration, launch, and every stage of future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with product teams at our founding partners, including Stripe, Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard, whose customers will be among the first to use Open USD.


This is an exciting opportunity to help shape Open Standard’s partner experience, take our earliest partnerships live, and convert a network of signed partners into a community of deeply engaged adopters.

**What you'll do**

* Launch new partners quickly by coordinating across Legal, Product, Compliance, and integration teams, ensuring launches happen in days, not weeks
* Develop tailored growth plans with each partner: define how Open USD fits their business, project transaction volumes for the first year, and identify key success drivers; lead quarterly reviews with partner leadership
* Connect partners within the network to foster collaboration and unlock new value as more companies adopt Open USD
* Serve as the single point of contact for partners after signing: manage launch announcements, handle reporting questions, and involve internal teams (Finance, Legal, Product) as needed
* Own the partner demand picture: build and maintain partner\-level forecasts that guide Liquidity, Finance, and Product planning
* Continuously improve our onboarding and product by turning every partner’s experience into future best practices and enhancements

**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform
* Have worked in a network or marketplace business where facilitating participant connections was part of your role
* Possess enough technical fluency to lead integration calls without needing a dedicated solutions engineer

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform (if not already mentioned above)
* Additional technical expertise to independently own integration conversations

**Logistics**

* **Location:** San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in\-office and remote days

**Come work with us**


Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $210K

jobs.title: Ancillary Services Network Account Manager
jobs.description:
Under the direction of the Manager of Ancillary Services, the Ancillary Services Contractor develops and maintains an Ancillary provider network that ensures Healthfirst members have superior access to the highest quality by focusing efforts on lowering claims costs, improving the quality of care, and increasing member and provider network satisfaction.The individual must possess experience working in a managed care setting with specific background in network development, provider recruitment, provider outreach, claim resolution, provider education and contract negotiations. Works with multiple provider types, e.g. physician, ancillary, medical groups, behavioral health or hospitals to supports a full range of contract arrangements and pricing mechanisms.  

* Monitor and audit contracted ancillary providers to ensure that accurate demographic, payment and fee schedules are loaded into the HF Provider System correctly.
* Manage a network of Ancillary Providers for all lines of Healthfirst's business (such as Medicaid, CHP, Medicare, and Commercial).
* Resolve configuration issues by identifying root causes in order to prevent claims denials and to ensure claims are paid correctly.
* Facilitate meetings cross\-departmentally to achieve positive outcomes in management of ancillary provider network.
* Create contracts in HF contract software and review credentialing documents submitted by Provider/facility via Universal Credentialing Data Source, The Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) or PDF application to ensure that all the required credentials are included and that valid documents for behavioral Providers and facilities are provided
* Negotiate and execute Single Patient Agreements for Out Of Network (OON) Providers in order to determine the Provider's payment arrangement.
* Individual should be familiar with contracting and reimbursement methodologies for ancillary services providers.
* Educate newly credentialed Providers on Healthfirst's policies and procedures such as billing and authorization requirements, utilization of Healthfirst's Provider portal, claims submission, etc., via various methods (telephonic, face\-to\-face, webinar, etc.).
* Analyze provider network based on monthly report to ensure that Plan is meeting Health Plan Network (HPN) State requirements.
* The individual would work closely with Network Management, Credentialing, and the business analytics unit within the Ancillary department, to complete the analysis.
* Identify root cause of claims issues and facilitate resolution by working closely with Reimbursement and Claims departments. Clearly communicate resolutions and progress to the Providers.
* Assist Appeals and Grievances (A\&G) department by acting as liaison between Providers and A\&G department to achieve favorable outcomes of member related issues, complaints, balance billing and other issues.
* Ensure that all Providers’ inquiries received via email and phone call are addressed efficiently and effectively within required time\-frame.
* Assist management with research and facilitation of projects related to contract updates, new product implementation and new reimbursement methodologies.
* Additional duties as assigned

  

Minimum Requirements:

* Experience managing or performing high level servicing to a portfolio of customers/providers
* Contracting experience \- Ability to work independently in dynamic environment
* Ability to take initiative and work independently
* Ability to prioritize and multi\-task
* Strong customer\-centric and analytical skills
* Strong sense of urgency and self\-motivational qualities
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* High School Diploma or GED

  

Hiring Range\*:

* Greater New York City Area (NY, NJ, CT residents): $68,900 \- $99,620
* All Other Locations (within approved locations): $61,300 \- $91,120



As a candidate for this position, your salary and related elements of compensation will be contingent upon your work experience, education, licenses and certifications, and any other factors Healthfirst deems pertinent to the hiring decision.



In addition to your salary, Healthfirst offers employees a full range of benefits such as, medical, dental and vision coverage, incentive and recognition programs, life insurance, and 401k contributions (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Healthfirst believes in providing a competitive compensation and benefits package wherever its employees work and live.


* *The hiring range is defined as the lowest and highest salaries that Healthfirst in “good faith” would pay to a new hire, or for a job promotion, or transfer into this role.*

And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!
